the S3 plan's §5 nondeterminism row: the caller's DOCSET_NONDET=1 is scrubbed by the suite (D33 hermetic_unset, measured 2026-09-10); the control sets it inside a wrapper driver passed with --driver (the plan corrected in its own commit, BBX-19)

the S3 plan's §6 screen line: the fixture register carries 15 fixture rows (12 expectation files + 3 truth logs), measured at bbx-11 over a kept suite run (the plan corrected in its own commit, BBX-19)

docs/generality.md's kind-B controls row: a `--crash-at` death is the guard — exit 2 with END-CRASH and the partial output kept (abstraction D4, bins B-X19), never exit 1; found while writing the S4 plan (bbx-12), corrected in its own commit when R35 was answered (BBX-19)

the S4 plan §4 and docs/generality.md kind B: the tool lives at fixture/fakecli/subject/fakecli.py so the file-sha1 whole-set key (dir_sha1 over the tool's directory, not recursive) covers the subject and never its generator or its config; measured at bbx-13 on the built fixture (the plan corrected in its own commit, BBX-19)

the S4 plan §4 options row: the tool carries 9 options — `--sleep <s>` is needed by §5's timeout control and the row had left it out; measured by the generator's NOTE at bbx-13 (the plan corrected in its own commit, BBX-19)

the S4 plan §4 refusals row: the tool refuses on 7 paths (6 at exit 2, cliguard's shape, and the unknown record at exit 1), counted by the generator's NOTE at bbx-13; the row had counted the two the scenarios exercise (the plan corrected in its own commit, BBX-19)

the S4 plan §3 S1: the search path CLI_PATH is the suite's variable (rompath_env = input_env), not scrubbed — the document-set profile's D33 shape, where DOCSET_PATH is not in hermetic_unset; the built profile (its register row is written with step 1) scrubs CLI_NONDET, CLI_TIMEOUT, CLI_KEEP_ENV (the plan corrected in its own commit before step 1 was built, BBX-19)

the S4 plan §4 commands row: 5 commands (list, show, stat, join, report) — `list --unordered` is an option of `list`, not a sixth command; measured by the generator's NOTE at bbx-13 (the plan corrected in its own commit, BBX-19)

the S4 plan §3 scenario grammar: `stdin` is an array of lines (one string each, newline-terminated) because a basic string holds no `\n` under the TOML subset BBX trusts (escapes are refused); `stdin_file` is relative to the scenario file's directory (the plan corrected in its own commit, BBX-19; the grammar's register row is written with step 1)

the S4 plan §3 E1 truth row and C3: compare_exact.py is NOT unchanged for its second consumer — its END rule counts the indices above zero, because the command-line grammar's exit point is index 0 and END is the last index (D47); found at bbx-15 by the first run of the exact family over a command-line log (every scenario FAILed on `END 9 … 10 indices`); the document-set verdicts byte-identical under the rule (the plan corrected in its own commit, BBX-19)

the S4 plan §5 JSON row: the suite's `NOT-EVALUATED (schema failed)` line on 03_show_json's truth pairing is asserted by the suite's gate (cli_suite.sh, step 4), not by the comparators' gate json_schema.sh, which runs no suite; the suite cannot run the fixture before step 4 decides how the JSON view reaches the schema family (the plan corrected in its own commit, BBX-19)

column5: the S4 plan §3 E1 and §8 step 4: the kinds loop is NOT unchanged for its second consumer — the kinds table gained a VIEW column (D57) and the loop one resolver (view_path), 29 lines added and 5 removed (git diff --numstat, measured on the shadow build at bbx-16), because the loop handed every family the subject file and the json format needs the driver's JSON view (measured at bbx-15 by gates/json_schema.sh); the plan corrected in its own commit (BBX-19)

the S4 plan §3 C1/C2: the tolerant-numeric branch no longer derives `<log>.bands` itself — the loop hands the band view from the kind's view column (D57) and compare_band takes it as its fourth argument, one resolver instead of two (BBX-16; found at bbx-16 when the view column was designed; the plan corrected in its own commit, BBX-19)

the S4 plan §6: the readout's screen reads `band, exact, multiset, schema` (the kept row's class column is the spec's class word, not the family's name) and `fixture 21` (12 files + 9 truth logs; the registry row is outside the set's histogram) — measured on the first readout over the command-line fixture at bbx-16 (the plan corrected in its own commit, BBX-19)

the S4 plan §7 feature-options row and §5 the --crash-at control row, and the fixture tool's own docstring: the deliberate crash no longer dies by SIGABRT — R42 (bbx-17) changed it to SIGKILL because os.abort() made macOS write a ~10 KB crash report into the maintainer's home for every deliberate death (23 on 2026-09-10 and 2 on 2026-09-11, zero before the control was built), an artifact outside the sandbox the driver promises to remove and declared by no line of its contract; measured both ways before the change — abort leaves one report and SIGKILL none, while the driver exits 2 either way and keeps the same three lines, the two crash logs differing only in the signal name (the plan corrected in its own commit, BBX-19)

R21's Linux procedure named the PRE-R28 baseline and the pre-rename remote: bbh's fidelity baseline is `10a82d2` since 2026-09-10 (R28, docs/rebaselines.md) and the remote is github.com/DefinitelyFrenchName/BBH-frame-based (renamed 2026-09-10; the old URL redirects). Measured at bbx-18: `git branch -r --contains 10a82d2` -> origin/main on that remote, and the clone needs an explicit directory name or BBX_BBH_HOME=../blackbox-harness points at nothing (the procedure corrected in place, BBX-19)

R21's expectation for the Linux run was written when the battery had ten gates; it registers 28 (24 portable + 4 static, measured 2026-09-11 from gates/portable.txt and gates/static.txt), with census_recount the one SKIP a host without the three macOS-local lineage paths is known to produce (the procedure corrected in place, BBX-19)

the D20 override reaches THREE gates, not two: gates/fidelity_bbh.sh, gates/fidelity_bbh_s2.sh and gates/suite.sh all read BBX_BBH_BASELINE (measured at bbx-18).
